title: Inverse-image fan centers and local saturated log blowup comparisons
statement:
Let $(V,N)$ be a locally Noetherian fs log scheme whose log structure is associated to one on the Zariski site [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], put $\overline N=N/\mathcal O_V^\times$ on its Zariski site, and let $c:(V,\overline N)\to(F,\mathcal P_F)$ be a local morphism to a fine fan with $c^{-1}\mathcal P_F\simeq\overline N$ [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. Let $J\subset\mathcal P_F$ be a nonempty coherent ideal. Let $\mathcal I\subset N$ be the inverse image of the ideal generated by $c^{-1}J$ in $\overline N$. Then $\mathcal I$ is a nonempty coherent log ideal and its saturated log blowup $b:(V',N')\to(V,N)$ exists, is locally Noetherian, and has a Zariski log structure.
Suppose on an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}A\subset V$ that $c$ takes values in the sharpened spectrum of a sharp fs monoid $P$, that $h:P\to\Gamma(U,N)$ is a log chart sharpening to $c|_U$, and that $J$ there is generated by a finite nonempty $E\subset P$. Then $\mathcal I|_U=(h(e):e\in E)N|_U$. Put
$$R_a=(\langle P,e-a\ (e\in E)\rangle)^{\mathrm{sat}}\subset P^{\mathrm{gp}}\qquad(a\in E).$$
The inverse image $b^{-1}U$ is covered by the log charts $U'_a=\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[P]}\mathbf Z[R_a])$ with monoid $R_a$. Here $\mathbf Z[T]$ is the ring of finite sums of symbols $z^t$ with $z^tz^{t'}=z^{t+t'}$, and tensor products are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. If $F'=\operatorname{Bl}^{\mathrm{sat}}_J(F)$, the chart homomorphism on each $U'_a$ induces a local morphism $(U'_a,\overline N')\to F'$ over $F$. For a geometric point $\bar w$ over $w\in U'_a$, let $H_w\subset R_a$ be the face of elements mapping to units at $w$. This morphism identifies its fan stalk and $\overline N'_{\bar w}$ canonically with $(R_a)_{H_w}/H_w^{\mathrm{gp}}$. These local morphisms have isomorphic inverse-image characteristic sheaves.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-fan-center-pullback-coherence] to get coherence hI and the ideal-generation equality hgen D for every affine-center input D.

Apply [lem-trf-coherent-log-ideal-chart-construction] to hI, and retain its single global fs blowup V',b and its family of tensor covers. Apply [lem-trf-fan-center-blowup-zariski] to this b to obtain the Zariski structure. Local Noetherianity is already a field of FineSaturatedLogScheme, so no separate Noetherian argument is needed in this assembly.

For each D, use h=hgen D to form D.idealChart h [def-trf-fan-center-tensor-chart-data]. Specialize the chart-construction family to this precise chart and retain its saturated cover C. For every supplied fan blowup beta and every a, apply [lem-trf-fan-center-tensor-chart-comparison] to b,h,C,beta,a. This produces all comparison maps, isomorphisms and normalization equations required by the original statement.
